findings.message: Criterion 5 requires test_host_contract_seam_inventory to check "the check-runner interface and additive frontmatter contract". Neither section 15 nor 19.P6.host-contract-doc defines what that interface is. Section 15 only names it. The facts exist only in merged code that is not in Context. chupa/gates.py holds the Gate protocol `check(artifact, workspace) -> GateReport`. chupa/mergequeue.py holds `host_checks`. It runs each `review.mechanical` argv: rc 0 passes and anything else fails. The tail is redacted and the output is spooled. `merge.safety_checks` must resolve to exactly one hard entry. When safety is off, only `trigger: always` hard entries run. The ticket frontmatter schema owner, which defines the additive-only rule, is also missing. This was checked by grepping and reading the code; the module that owns the frontmatter schema was not located. Without these files the implementer would have to guess what the doc says and what the test pins, which breaks read-before-write.
findings.paved_road: Add chupa/gates.py, chupa/mergequeue.py and the module that owns the ticket frontmatter schema to `## Context`. Or narrow criterion 5's check-runner clause to name the concrete merged facts it pins: the argv list, rc 0 means pass, the exactly-one-hard safety_checks resolution and the always/hard integration selection. Leave the fence unchanged.
